notes.title: Project Solaris Demo Ver.0.6 Major Update Released!
notes.content:
Project Solaris Demo Ver.0.6 Update Details


Ver.0.6 brings a wide range of updates including combat system improvements, UI enhancements, and updated tutorials.
[hr][/hr]
▼ Major Changes

Added skill enhancement system & new animations for Hom’s skills
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277471/37ed3ea1178d9285e8c86a8037f6332cb779f4a4.png"]

Buff and debuff effects greatly expanded (from 5 types to 38)

Initial Hom skills changed (from 3 types to 6)

Revised how Hom's skills are selected during each turn
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277471/60756a99ef8754630679c5f44138ddc05a200c95.png"]

Revamped card graphics in the card selection screen

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277471/1386413c654294315ca9a4c6644bdc7939a0874a.png"]

Skill list now shows color coding and level indicators

Equipment section in the development screen improved (added animated cursor)

Buff/debuff effect descriptions now appear on mouse hover in the help section

Added pop-up descriptions for battle and interaction rewards

Rebalanced the ratio of battle/interaction rewards

Reduced overall game data size and memory usage

Fully reworked tutorial content
[hr][/hr]
📢 Please try out the updated demo and let us know your feedback!
